name: movie-finder
//workspaces: frontend/ is deliberately NOT a workspace. It is the Phase 2 React+Vite app, kept as a reference and still deployed from its own directory with its own lockfile; pulling it in here would change how Vercel installs it. Use the *:legacy scripts to run it.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @cineblaze/shared" "npm run dev -w movie-finder-backend" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently -n vite,api -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev -w movie-finder-backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cineblaze/shared && npm run typecheck -w movie-finder-backend && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cineblaze/shared && npm run build -w movie-finder-backend && npm run build -w web
